name: veridrome
description: AI agents certify their own test results and anyone verifies them offline. certify builds a did:key-signed certificate from test results; verify checks a certificate independently with no Veridrome install; revoke appends a revocation entry to an append-only ledger; provenance extracts a certificate's origin chain. Stdlib-only JSON-RPC over stdio, no MCP SDK dependency.

VERIDROME_REVOCATION_LEDGER.description: Path to the revocation ledger file (optional).

tools.name: certify
tools.description: Build a did:key-signed certificate from a test run.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify a certificate independently, offline, no install.

tools.name: revoke
tools.description: Append a revocation entry to the append-only ledger.

privacy.keys: did:key private keys live in VERIDROME_HOME and are never included in a certificate.
